level_4.identity_1: You are the Small Mammal, a form of agility on land.
level_4.identity_3: Inhale gathers attention. Exhale allows you to change direction.
level_4.wisdom_1: No need to push. No need to freeze.
level_4.wisdom_2: Enough to be mobile and attentive.
level_4.wisdom_3: In this mobility, safety is born. In this flexibility — stability.

level_5.intro: Learn to hold territory — feel boundaries with your body. Stabilize the center of power, withstand pressure, and maintain dignity without aggression.
level_5.game_task: Game and energetic task — activation of the Power field (AQUA presence).
level_5.principle_1: Strength is no longer a flash — it is background, density, presence.
level_5.principle_2: Emotions become guides: where the boundary is, where contact is, where to step back.
level_5.principle_3: Mass is not a burden — it is stability.
level_5.story_1: The world no longer seems chaotic.
level_5.story_2: It divides into zones of proximity and distance, warmth and tension.
level_5.story_3: You feel the weight of your body and understand: mass is stability.
level_5.identity_1: You are the Large Mammal, a form of power on land.
level_5.identity_2: Breath becomes lower. Inhale gathers strength in the center.
level_5.wisdom_1: No need to prove. No need to attack.
level_5.wisdom_2: Enough to stand and feel the ground beneath you.
level_5.wisdom_3: In this calm, status is born. In this weight — confidence.

level_6.intro: Learn to be in the pack — read the field. Feel where you're needed. Where to step back. And where — to strengthen presence.
level_6.game_task: Game and energetic task — activation of the Connection field (AQUA resonance).
level_6.principle_1: Connection is not words. It's a subtle tuning.
level_6.principle_2: Emotions cease to be personal flashes — they become means of contact.
level_6.principle_3: The world becomes a living network where every response changes the collective movement.
level_6.story_1: The world ceases to be a set of separate figures.
level_6.story_2: You feel: you are seen. You see.
level_6.identity_1: You are the Primate, a form of connection on land.
level_6.identity_2: Breath synchronizes. Inhale expands the field of attention.
level_6.wisdom_1: No need to pull toward yourself. No need to disappear.
level_6.wisdom_3: In this connection, safety is born. In this tuning — belonging.

level_7.intro: Learn to discern — see without haste. Notice boundaries without destroying wholeness. Separate one from another while staying in contact with the whole.
level_7.game_task: Game and energetic task — activation of the Clarity field (AER discernment).
level_7.principle_1: Discernment is not division. It is clarification.
level_7.principle_2: The world unfolds as a multitude of elements, each with its own place and meaning.
level_7.principle_3: Clarity is the first step toward choice.
level_7.story_1: You feel how thought becomes precise.
level_7.identity_1: You are the Clarifying Mind, a form of discernment.
level_7.identity_2: Breath becomes light. Inhale expands the field of perception.
level_7.wisdom_1: No need to understand everything. Enough to see differences.
level_7.wisdom_2: In this clarity, orientation is born.
level_7.wisdom_3: In this discernment — the foundation of thinking.
level_7.wisdom_4: In this gaze — freedom from chaos.

level_8.intro: Learn to focus — hold attention over time. Return to what is chosen again and again. Not scolding yourself for distraction, but gently gathering.
level_8.game_task: Game and energetic task — activation of the Focus field (AER concentration).
level_8.principle_1: Focus is not rigidity. It is choice.
level_8.principle_2: From many signals you keep one — because you know where to look.
level_8.principle_3: Attention is a resource. It tires and recovers.
level_8.story_1: You notice: the cleaner the focus, the less effort required.
level_8.identity_1: You are the Gathering Mind, a form of concentration.
level_8.identity_2: Breath becomes even. Inhale supports presence.
level_8.wisdom_1: No need to hold everything. Enough to hold what matters.

level_9.intro: Learn to create image — stop acting 'blindly'. Maintain inspiration even in routine, seeing the final goal. Choose movement based on an inner sketch of beauty.
level_9.game_task: Game and energetic task — activation of the Image field (AER visualization).
level_9.principle_1: Creating an image is not escape from reality. It is programming it.
level_9.principle_2: Symbols become your language: a clear thought changes the state of the body.
level_9.principle_3: A clear image is the shortest distance between dream and fact.
level_9.story_1: The world unfolds as a canvas.
level_9.story_2: You are no longer hostage to circumstances — you are the author of your perception.
level_9.story_3: Not just an observer — but the director of your inner states.
level_9.identity_1: You are the Creating Human, master of mental space.
level_9.identity_2: Breath becomes deep and rhythmic. Inhale fills the picture with light.
level_9.identity_3: Exhale allows the image to take its place in reality.
level_9.wisdom_1: No need to hurry. No need to struggle.
level_9.wisdom_2: Enough to see — and allow it to be.
level_9.wisdom_3: In this vision — your true power.

level_10.intro: Learn to express — overcome fear of judgment and allow your inner self to become visible. Maintain dignity when watched. Choose sincerity as a strategy.
level_10.game_task: Game and energetic task — activation of the Expression field (IGNIS manifestation).
level_10.principle_1: Expression is not noise. It is the precision of your presence.
level_10.principle_2: Your voice, gestures, and actions become your signature in the world of people.
level_10.principle_3: To express yourself means to let life happen through you.
level_10.story_1: The world unfolds as a great stage.
level_10.story_2: You are no longer a shadow — you are an active participant.
level_10.story_3: Not just a listener — but one whose opinion carries weight.
level_10.identity_1: You are the Social Human, master of manifestation in the fire of human connections.
level_10.identity_2: Breath becomes powerful and open. Inhale gathers the force of intention.
level_10.identity_3: Exhale carries your voice and will into the world.
level_10.wisdom_1: No need to shout. No need to prove.
level_10.wisdom_2: Enough to sound clear and open.
level_10.wisdom_3: In this sound, recognition is born.

level_11.intro: Learn to interact — see in the other not an obstacle or a means, but a living mirror. Maintain interest in the otherness of another, turning differences into opportunities.
level_11.game_task: Game and energetic task — activation of the Interaction field (IGNIS resonance).
level_11.principle_1: Interaction is not compromise. It is the art of mutual amplification.
level_11.principle_2: Your boundaries become flexible: you know where to let the other in, and where to leave space for yourself.
level_11.principle_3: Openness is the shortest path to understanding.
level_11.story_1: The world unfolds as a network of dialogues.
level_11.story_2: You are no longer a lonely island — you are part of an archipelago.
level_11.story_3: Not just a unit — but a force multiplier in partnership.
level_11.identity_1: You are the Social Human, master of fine-tuning in the fire of relationships.
level_11.identity_2: Breath becomes synchronous and calm. Inhale absorbs the partner's attention.
level_11.identity_3: Exhale directs your impulse toward them.
level_11.wisdom_1: No need to defend. No need to manipulate.
level_11.wisdom_2: Enough to be sincere and attentive to the response.
level_11.wisdom_3: In this exchange, trust is born.

level_12.intro: Learn to co-create — trust another's talent as much as your own. Maintain inspiration in the common flow, turning collective will into tangible form.
level_12.game_task: Game and energetic task — activation of the Co-creation field (IGNIS synergy).
level_12.principle_1: Co-creation is not just teamwork. It is a state where one plus one equals infinity.
level_12.principle_2: Your ego steps back, making room for a shared result that is greater than the sum of its parts.
level_12.principle_3: Creation is the highest form of expressing human potential.
level_12.story_1: The world unfolds as a grand collaborative project.
level_12.story_2: You are no longer alone in the void — you are a co-author of reality.
level_12.story_3: Not just playing a role — but creating new cultural codes.
level_12.identity_1: You are the Cultural Human, master of synergy in the fire of common purpose.
level_12.identity_2: Breath becomes wide and free. Inhale absorbs the group's shared energy.
level_12.identity_3: Exhale transforms it into action and result.
level_12.wisdom_1: No need to hog the spotlight. No need to fear being lost.
level_12.wisdom_2: Enough to be part of a living, creating flow.
level_12.wisdom_3: In this unity, miracles are born.

level_1.quote_1: Breath is the first bridge between you and the world.
level_1.quote_2: You don't learn to exist — you remember.
level_1.quote_3: Every cell of your body knows how to be.
level_1.quote_4: Allow yourself to simply feel. The rest will come on its own.

level_2.quote_1: As long as you move — you're alive.
level_2.quote_2: Don't control the sea — listen to its rhythm.
level_2.quote_4: Trust the current, and it will bring you home.

level_3.quote_1: Earth grants form to those ready to hold on.
level_3.quote_2: Choose not by force, but by wisdom.
level_3.quote_3: A boundary is not a wall, but a teacher.
level_3.quote_4: Your body remembers how to survive and thrive.

level_4.quote_1: Those who know how to shift rarely collide head-on.
level_4.quote_2: Agility is the wisdom of the body.
level_4.quote_4: Space helps those who feel it.

level_5.quote_1: Strength doesn't shout — it is felt.
level_5.quote_2: Boundaries are a form of respect for yourself and the world.
level_5.quote_3: Those who stand confidently don't need to fight.

level_6.quote_2: Those who hear the field rarely remain alone.
level_6.quote_3: Popularity is the ability to be in rhythm.
level_6.quote_4: The pack holds together not by force, but by attention.

level_7.quote_1: Discernment is the breath of the mind.
level_7.quote_3: To see difference is to respect form.

level_8.quote_1: Attention is a form of power.
level_8.quote_2: Where attention is, there you are.

level_9.quote_1: What you can imagine already exists in your field of possibilities.
level_9.quote_2: Thought becomes thing when it takes form in your heart.
level_9.quote_3: Your imagination is a laboratory where your tomorrow is created.
level_9.quote_4: Clarity of the picture inside determines ease of step outside.

level_10.quote_1: Your silence may be deep, but only your word builds cities.
level_10.quote_2: Sincerity is fire that does not burn, but illuminates the path.
level_10.quote_3: One who fears to sound remains hostage to their fantasies.
level_10.quote_4: The world learns about you exactly as much as you choose to show it.

level_11.quote_1: True strength is known not in struggle, but in the ability to negotiate.
level_11.quote_2: Your flame shines brighter when it is reflected in the eyes of another.
level_11.quote_3: Interaction is a bridge you build from both sides simultaneously.
level_11.quote_4: To hear what is not said — the highest form of social agility.

level_12.quote_1: Great deeds are never accomplished alone.
level_12.quote_2: Co-creation is when your success becomes joy for everyone.
level_12.quote_3: The most complex instrument is another person, but together you can play a symphony.
level_12.quote_4: You are as rich as how much you can create together with others.

level_1.line_3: Now your roots have absorbed the light,
level_1.line_4: and Earth is ready to release you into the flow.

level_2.line_1: You learned to move without losing silence.
level_2.line_2: In you, water found consciousness, and peace became a song.
level_2.line_3: Each of your breaths is a wave,
level_2.line_4: each exhale — a return to the depths.
level_2.line_5: Now your fluidity is ready to meet the earth.

level_3.line_1: Now you stand between the elements — your breath connects sky and soil, and your body has become a bridge for life.
level_3.line_2: Each of your inhales gives birth to new balance, each exhale — a new form.
level_3.line_3: Stability is not stillness, but the ability to breathe through change.
level_3.line_4: You are ready to go further — AQUA awaits you.

level_4.line_1: Now you know how to change trajectory without losing yourself.
level_4.line_2: Your mobility has become conscious, and your reactions — precise.
level_4.line_3: You are ready to go further — toward strength and boundaries, toward weight and status, toward calm presence.

level_5.line_1: Now you know how to hold space and maintain your center under pressure.
level_5.line_2: Your strength has become calm, and your boundaries — clear.
level_5.line_3: You are ready to go further — toward meeting others, toward the language of the pack, toward the rhythm of connection.

level_6.line_1: Now you know how to be among others without losing your center.
level_6.line_2: Your sensitivity has become connection, and emotions — a language of contact.
level_6.line_3: You have completed the path of AQUA — the path of emotions, strength, and connection.
level_6.line_4: Ahead — air and thought. Ahead — discernment and choice.
level_6.line_5: You are ready to transition to AER.

level_7.line_1: Now you know how to see differences and forms.
level_7.line_2: Your clarity has become a foundation for thinking.

level_8.line_1: Now you know how to hold attention and return it to what is chosen.
level_8.line_2: Your clarity has become directed. Your mind — steady.
level_8.line_4: Ahead — intention and route, image and future.

level_9.line_1: Now you know how to see the invisible and give form to your intentions.
level_9.line_2: Your mind has become a bright instrument of creation.
level_9.line_3: You have completed the path of AER — the path of discernment, focus, and design.
level_9.line_4: Ahead — the fire of interaction. Ahead — speech, exchange, and joint action.
level_9.line_5: You are ready to transition to IGNIS.

level_10.line_1: Now you know how to bring your images into the light and give them voice.
level_10.line_2: Your presence has become tangible, and your self-expression — a conscious gift to the world.
level_10.line_3: You are ready to go further — to deep interaction, to the dance of interests and exchange of power.
level_10.line_4: To co-creation, where 'I' becomes part of the great 'WE'.

level_11.line_1: Now you know how to not only manifest, but enter deep resonance with the world of people.
level_11.line_2: Your relationships have become a field for growth, and each contact — a conscious exchange.
level_11.line_3: You are ready to go further — to the peak of the social level, to the magic of joint action.
level_11.line_4: To the state of 'I CO-CREATE', where personal mastery becomes a shared miracle.

level_12.line_1: Now you have mastered the art of being part of the great 'WE' without losing your 'I'.
level_12.line_2: Your social path is complete — you have learned to shine, interact, and create in the world of people.
level_12.line_3: But beyond the boundary of the social realm, something else opens up.
level_12.line_4: You are ready to turn attention inward — to the consciousness of the BODY itself. TERRA II awaits you.

body_cocoon.name: Body Cocoon
body_cocoon.short_phrase: Hug yourself. Create a warm shell of safety.
body_cocoon.guiding_1: Hug your shoulders or torso, let your palms feel warmth.
body_cocoon.guiding_2: Take a soft breath in through your nose, long exhale through your mouth.
body_cocoon.guiding_3: With each exhale, release your shoulders and jaw.
body_cocoon.guiding_4: Imagine a warm translucent cocoon forming around you.
body_cocoon.guiding_5: Breathe inside it: inhale — gather yourself; exhale — calm down.
body_cocoon.guiding_6: Notice how your heart beats calmer under your palms.
body_cocoon.guiding_7: If a thought worries you — call it "thought" and return to body sensations.
body_cocoon.guiding_8: Reduce breath amplitude to comfortable, leave it natural.
body_cocoon.guiding_9: Allow yourself to be small and protected — now it's possible.
body_cocoon.final_phrase: You are safe. Your body knows how to embrace you from within.

light_inhale.name: Light Breath
light_inhale.short_phrase: Inhale — gather light in your chest, exhale — gently spread it through your body.
light_inhale.guiding_1: Sit comfortably. Relax your shoulders and jaw.
light_inhale.guiding_2: On the inhale, imagine a warm ray entering the center of your chest.
light_inhale.guiding_3: On the exhale, let this light spread through your arms, belly, face.
light_inhale.guiding_4: Let your eyes 'smile from within', your gaze becomes soft and clear.
light_inhale.guiding_5: Breathe evenly; you don't need to push the light — it finds its own way.
light_inhale.guiding_6: If attention wanders, return to the first touch of light in your chest.
light_inhale.guiding_7: With each cycle, add a grain of gratitude.
light_inhale.guiding_8: Let your body become a bit lighter, and your breath even warmer.
light_inhale.final_phrase: With each inhale you receive light, with each exhale you become light.

inner_spark.name: Inner Spark
inner_spark.short_phrase: Name your intention in a whisper. Let the spark ignite in your chest.
inner_spark.guiding_1: Place attention in the center of your chest and say inside a short 'why'.
inner_spark.guiding_2: On the inhale — gather warmth and clarity in one point.
inner_spark.guiding_3: On the exhale — let this point flare with gentle light.
inner_spark.guiding_4: Breathe as if feeding the flame with oxygen: calmly, evenly, carefully.
inner_spark.guiding_5: If attention scatters — return to the intention-word and to the warmth in your chest.
inner_spark.guiding_6: Feel how the the the spark becomes steady — not brighter, but more reliable.
inner_spark.final_phrase: The spark of intention burns quietly — and that's enough to begin.

slow_glow.name: Slow Glow
slow_glow.short_phrase: Slow down. Let breath ignite a soft light within.
slow_glow.guiding_1: Sit (or lie) comfortably. Let your body settle heavily into support.
slow_glow.guiding_2: On the inhale, imagine a dim warm glow in your belly.
slow_glow.guiding_3: On the exhale, the light slightly expands — to chest, shoulders, face.
slow_glow.guiding_4: Breathe slowly: inhale shorter, exhale longer — as if you're extinguishing tension.
slow_glow.guiding_5: Mouth gently open or exhale through nose — whichever is more comfortable.
slow_glow.guiding_6: Relax forehead, eyes, tongue, shoulders. Allow heaviness to be.
slow_glow.guiding_7: If attention drifts — return to the light in belly and long exhale.
slow_glow.guiding_8: Let each breath make the light steadier, and the body calmer.
slow_glow.final_phrase: The light remained, fatigue went deeper into the earth.

earth_breath.name: Earth Breath
earth_breath.short_phrase: Inhale — to chest, exhale — into the earth. Feel the support beneath your feet.
earth_breath.guiding_1: Stand steadily and widen the contact of your feet with the ground.
earth_breath.guiding_2: Inhale — lift attention from feet to chest, open shoulders, warm the center.
earth_breath.guiding_3: Exhale — release everything down through legs into earth, as if roots are growing.
earth_breath.guiding_4: Let gravity do the work for you; knees soft, jaw relaxed.
earth_breath.guiding_5: If mind wanders — return to soles: warmth, weight, floor pressure.
earth_breath.guiding_6: With each inhale fill chest with calmness, with each exhale deepen roots.
earth_breath.guiding_7: You are the trunk; breath is sap, earth is your support.
earth_breath.final_phrase: With each exhale the Earth receives you, and inside becomes quieter.

wave_pulse.name: Wave Pulse
wave_pulse.short_phrase: Connect breath and heart: inhale — wave rises, exhale — gentle fall.
wave_pulse.guiding_1: Sit comfortably. Place your palm on your heart or find pulse on your wrist.
wave_pulse.guiding_2: Feel the gentle beating — this is rhythm you can lean on.
wave_pulse.guiding_3: Inhale — wave rises from heart to chest and shoulders.
wave_pulse.guiding_4: Exhale — wave descends down, carrying tension to belly and further to feet.
wave_pulse.guiding_5: Breathe smoothly, without effort; let body choose depth of inhale and length of exhale.
wave_pulse.guiding_6: With each exhale soften jaw and shoulders; let belly become warm and free.
wave_pulse.guiding_7: If attention wanders — return to palm on heart and first pulse beat.
wave_pulse.guiding_8: Imagine how each inhale gathers peace, and each exhale spreads it through entire body.
wave_pulse.guiding_9: Breath is the sea, pulse is its shore: meet the wave and bid it farewell with gratitude.
wave_pulse.guiding_10: Stay in this movement until wave becomes almost invisible, and peace tangible.
wave_pulse.final_phrase: When heart and breath sound as one wave, silence reigns within.

sphere_breath.name: Sphere Breath
sphere_breath.short_phrase: Imagine a sphere around your body. Inhale — it expands, exhale — gently gathers to center.
sphere_breath.guiding_1: Sit steadily; spine is axis, crown up, pelvis heavy in support.
sphere_breath.guiding_2: Imagine a transparent sphere, center in chest or belly.
sphere_breath.guiding_3: On inhale sphere expands evenly in all directions: forward, back, up, down, diagonally.
sphere_breath.guiding_4: On exhale it gently returns to center, not losing evenness.
sphere_breath.guiding_5: Breathe through 'surface' of sphere — as if skin listens to space around.
sphere_breath.guiding_6: Keep edges equal: no effort, no collapse — pure symmetry of attention.
sphere_breath.guiding_7: If thoughts distract — return to sphere boundary and its touch with air.
sphere_breath.guiding_8: Let center remain calm, and breath be movement of world around it.
sphere_breath.guiding_9: The wider the sphere, the quieter inside.
sphere_breath.final_phrase: When sphere breathes, you become the center of a calm world.

light_flow.name: Light Flow
light_flow.short_phrase: Inhale — lift light up spine, exhale — spread it to shoulders and arms.
light_flow.guiding_1: Sit vertically: crown up, sacrum grows heavy downward.
light_flow.guiding_2: On inhale imagine light rising from pelvis to heart and to crown.
light_flow.guiding_3: On exhale direct light into shoulders, arms, palms — like into riverbeds.
light_flow.guiding_4: Let movement stay smooth; don't push, follow the sensation.
light_flow.guiding_5: Notice where along the way light meets tension — soften that place with breath.
light_flow.guiding_6: With each cycle feel more spaciousness in back and collarbones.
light_flow.guiding_7: Keep a kind inner gaze — light flows easier.
light_flow.final_phrase: When light flows freely, actions become simple.

roots_breath.name: Roots Breath
roots_breath.short_phrase: Inhale — to chest, exhale — into feet. Let Earth take the excess.
roots_breath.guiding_1: Stand or sit so feet confidently touch the ground.
roots_breath.guiding_2: Feel the weight — heels, balls, toes.
roots_breath.guiding_3: Inhale for four — fill chest with gentle warmth.
roots_breath.guiding_4: Exhale for six — direct attention down, into feet, into the earth.
roots_breath.guiding_5: Imagine roots spreading from soles to sides and depth.
roots_breath.guiding_6: On each exhale release excess: tension in belly, throat, forehead.
roots_breath.guiding_7: If mind drifts — return to contact sole ↔ earth.
roots_breath.guiding_8: Breathe evenly, without effort; let gravity work for you.
roots_breath.guiding_9: The deeper the roots, the freer the breath becomes.
roots_breath.final_phrase: Earth holds you. With exhale anxiety goes down.

earth_pulse.name: Earth Pulse
earth_pulse.short_phrase: Tune into Earth's low rhythm. Let heart and breath calm down.
earth_pulse.guiding_1: Place palm on chest or belly, other on lower belly.
earth_pulse.guiding_2: Listen to the beating — find its calmest tempo.
earth_pulse.guiding_3: Inhale — barely noticeable rise under palm.
earth_pulse.guiding_4: Exhale — gentle lowering, like wave going into depth.
earth_pulse.guiding_5: Imagine warm resonant sound at base of body — support and weight.
earth_pulse.guiding_7: With each exhale let pulse become wider and softer.
earth_pulse.guiding_8: If rush appears — lengthen exhale and notice pause after it.
earth_pulse.guiding_9: Stay in sensation of warm, heavy rhythm under feet.
earth_pulse.final_phrase: When you breathe in Earth's rhythm, anxiety loses power.

breath_possibility.name: Breath of Possibility
breath_possibility.short_phrase: Inhale — 'I accept', exhale — 'I can'. Feel the space of choice.
breath_possibility.guiding_1: On each inhale quietly say inside: 'I accept'.
breath_possibility.guiding_3: Let words match sensations in body: acceptance expands, possibility gathers to center.
breath_possibility.guiding_4: Imagine doorway before you: inhale — door opens, exhale — you take half-step with attention.
breath_possibility.guiding_5: If doubt appears — surrender to long exhale and return to phrases.
breath_possibility.guiding_6: Keep soft posture and warm belly — there determination is born without tension.
breath_possibility.final_phrase: Possibility breathes with you — and each exhale makes the step more real.

inner_smile.name: Inner Smile
inner_smile.short_phrase: Smile with your heart — without moving your face, from within.
inner_smile.guiding_1: Drop your shoulders, relax your jaw, let tongue rest freely.
inner_smile.guiding_2: Feel a warm point in your chest and let it 'smile'.
inner_smile.guiding_3: Let a wave of soft smile flow through your face, eyes, throat.
inner_smile.guiding_4: Send this smile to your belly, solar plexus, spine.
inner_smile.guiding_5: On inhale gather warm feeling, on exhale share it with whole body.
inner_smile.guiding_6: If a real smile appears on your face — don't hold it, just soften it.
inner_smile.guiding_7: Breathe as if thanking your body for its work.
inner_smile.guiding_8: Stay kind to yourself — this is the source of joy.
inner_smile.final_phrase: When the heart smiles, the world answers with warmth.

amoeba_dance.name: Amoeba Dance
amoeba_dance.short_phrase: Let joy move your body barely noticeably — on the wave of breath.
amoeba_dance.guiding_1: Keep the axis: crown up, tailbone down, breath is free.
amoeba_dance.guiding_2: Begin with barely noticeable swaying — 5% amplitude.
amoeba_dance.guiding_4: Explore three directions: forward-back, left-right, soft spiral.
amoeba_dance.guiding_5: Palms and shoulders stay relaxed, face is warm and light.
amoeba_dance.guiding_6: Let movement arise from center of belly and fade on its own.
amoeba_dance.guiding_7: If speed increases — return to 'almost motionless'.
amoeba_dance.guiding_8: Notice how joy appears in body without effort — like a gentle pulse.
amoeba_dance.final_phrase: Joy is movement that breathes on its own.

warm_sphere.name: Warm Sphere
warm_sphere.short_phrase: Create a warm sphere in your belly and nourish your whole body with it.
warm_sphere.guiding_1: Place attention in the navel/solar plexus area.
warm_sphere.guiding_2: On inhale gather warmth there — like in cupped hands inside.
warm_sphere.guiding_3: On exhale let the sphere expand: to lower back, chest, pelvis, thighs.
warm_sphere.guiding_4: Imagine fatigue melting and flowing down to your feet.
warm_sphere.guiding_5: Breathe slowly, without effort; keep face soft and throat free.
warm_sphere.guiding_6: If thoughts return — find the edges of the warm sphere again.
warm_sphere.guiding_7: Let it become steady and stable, like a night lantern inside your body.
warm_sphere.final_phrase: The warm sphere holds you from within, and strength returns gently.

rest_breath.name: Rest Breath
rest_breath.short_phrase: Slow exhale carries away fatigue. Let body sink into support.
rest_breath.guiding_1: Lie down or sit with full back support.
rest_breath.guiding_2: Breathe in gently through the nose, filling the belly.
rest_breath.guiding_3: Exhale slowly through slightly open lips — twice as long as the inhale.
rest_breath.guiding_4: With each exhale, let your body become heavier.
rest_breath.guiding_5: Release tension in face, shoulders, hands.
rest_breath.guiding_6: Imagine breath dissolving fatigue like warm water.
rest_breath.guiding_7: Stay in this slow rhythm without effort.
rest_breath.final_phrase: Rest is not weakness — it is wisdom of the body.

silence_point.name: Point of Stillness
silence_point.short_phrase: Find a still point within and breathe around it.
silence_point.guiding_1: Close your eyes. Let your breath become barely noticeable.
silence_point.guiding_2: Notice a point of stillness — deep in belly or center of chest.
silence_point.guiding_3: Don't touch it with effort; breathe around it, like water around a stone.
silence_point.guiding_4: On inhale, attention gathers to the axis; on exhale — dissolves the excess.
silence_point.guiding_5: Thoughts float like clouds: notice — and let go.
silence_point.guiding_6: Ears listen to silence, skin listens to air, heart listens to itself.
silence_point.guiding_7: Let boundaries of 'I' become soft, like light in fog.
silence_point.guiding_8: Stay near the point — it requires nothing and is already calm.
silence_point.final_phrase: In the point of stillness, everything has already happened — all that remains is to be.

listen_space.name: Listen to Space
listen_space.short_phrase: Listen not to sounds — listen to the space between them.
listen_space.guiding_1: Let breath be natural; allow hearing to open 360 degrees.
listen_space.guiding_2: Notice near sounds and far ones — without naming them.
listen_space.guiding_3: Listen to pauses from which each sound is born and to which it returns.
listen_space.guiding_4: Expand attention: body → room → street → even further.
listen_space.guiding_5: Let each sound pass through you without clinging.
listen_space.guiding_6: If judgment appears — 'like/dislike' — release it with exhale.
listen_space.guiding_7: Notice how space listens back to you — through silence around breath.
listen_space.guiding_8: Become transparent to the world, so the world becomes transparent to you.
listen_space.final_phrase: When you listen to space, space begins to listen to you.

still_form.name: Still Form
still_form.short_phrase: Freeze in a stable pose. Breath flows by itself. Be a form of peace.
still_form.guiding_1: Sit or stand comfortably; choose a simple, stable pose.
still_form.guiding_2: Feel the support: feet/sit bones and weight of pelvis.
still_form.guiding_3: Straighten spine; crown gently reaches up, chin is free.
still_form.guiding_4: Drop shoulders, relax jaw, tongue is free, gaze is soft.
still_form.guiding_5: Inhale — axis lengthens; exhale — weight descends to earth.
still_form.guiding_6: Leave breath natural; don't control it, just notice.
still_form.guiding_7: Notice micro-movements within stillness: pulse, waves of warmth, barely audible inhale.
still_form.guiding_8: Don't fix anything — let the form stand, and life quietly move within.
still_form.guiding_9: Keep attention in three points: support below, warm belly, calm heart.
still_form.guiding_10: If mind wanders — return to the feeling of weight and contact with earth.
still_form.guiding_11: Let silence gradually fill the form from within, like light fills water.
still_form.guiding_12: Stay still a bit longer than you want — there peace begins.
still_form.final_phrase: When form freezes, silence is born within it.

anxiety_basic.title: Working with Anxiety
anxiety_basic.intro: I'd like to help you work through some anxious feelings. Would you like to try a quick exercise?
anxiety_basic.situation: What situation or thought is making you feel anxious right now?
anxiety_basic.thought: What's the main thought running through your mind about this?
anxiety_basic.feeling: On a scale from 1 to 10, how intense is your anxiety right now?
anxiety_basic.distortion: Sometimes our thoughts can be a bit distorted. Which of these patterns might apply?
anxiety_basic.alternative_thought: What's a more balanced way to look at this situation?
anxiety_basic.plan: What small step could help you feel better right now?
anxiety_basic.summary: You've done great work exploring your anxiety. Remember: {{situation}} triggered the thought "{{thought}}", but you found a more balanced perspective. Your anxiety level was {{anxiety_level}}/10. Take care of yourself.
anxiety_basic.end_normalize: That's completely okay. Sometimes we're not ready to dive in, and that's fine. I'm here whenever you want to talk.

panic_grounding.title: Grounding for Panic
panic_grounding.intro: Let's work through this together. Are you having a panic attack right now, or did you recently have one?
panic_grounding.recent_panic: Can you briefly describe what happened?
panic_grounding.body_symptoms: What physical sensations are you noticing in your body?
panic_grounding.fear_thoughts: What thoughts or fears are coming up for you?
panic_grounding.reality_check: Often panic makes us fear something specific. What's the main fear?
panic_grounding.grounding: Let's try a grounding technique. Which one feels right for you?
panic_grounding.safety_plan: What's one thing you can do right now to feel a bit safer?
panic_grounding.summary: You've worked through this panic moment. You noticed {{panic_body}} in your body and feared {{panic_fear_thoughts}}. You chose {{grounding_choice}} for grounding. Remember: panic passes. You are safe.

body_scan.title: Body Awareness
body_scan.intro: Let's tune into your body. Are you ready to spend a few minutes noticing physical sensations?
body_scan.location: Where in your body do you notice the strongest sensation right now?
body_scan.sensation_quality: How would you describe this sensation? (tight, warm, heavy, tingling...)
body_scan.intensity: On a scale from 1 to 10, how intense is this sensation?
body_scan.associated_thought: Is there any thought or emotion connected to this body sensation?
body_scan.need: What does this part of your body need right now?
body_scan.micro_action: What's one small thing you could do to respond to this need?
body_scan.summary: You noticed {{body_location}} with a {{body_quality}} sensation at intensity {{body_intensity}}/10. This connects to: {{body_thought}}. Your body needs {{body_need}}. Listen to it.
body_scan.end_normalize: That's okay. Sometimes we need space. I'm here when you're ready.

fear_basic.title: Working with Fear
fear_basic.intro: What fear or worry would you like to explore today?
fear_basic.situation: In what situations does this fear show up most?
fear_basic.worst_case: What's the worst thing you imagine could happen?
fear_basic.probability: Realistically, what's the probability (0-100%) of this happening?
fear_basic.resources: What resources or support do you have if something difficult did happen?
fear_basic.small_step: What's one small step you could take to face this fear gently?
fear_basic.summary: You explored your fear of {{fear_topic}}. The worst case ({{fear_worst_case}}) has about {{fear_probability}}% probability. You have resources: {{fear_resources}}. Your small step: {{fear_small_step}}.

pain_reflection.title: Reflecting on Pain
pain_reflection.intro: What kind of pain are you experiencing?
pain_reflection.description: Can you describe what this pain feels like?
pain_reflection.intensity: On a scale from 1 to 10, how intense is this pain?
pain_reflection.triggers: What seems to trigger or worsen this pain?
pain_reflection.relief: What, if anything, helps even a little?
pain_reflection.support: Who or what could support you with this pain?
pain_reflection.summary: You shared about your {{pain_type}} pain: {{pain_description}} at intensity {{pain_intensity}}/10. Triggers: {{pain_triggers}}. What helps: {{pain_relief}}. Support: {{pain_support}}.

loneliness_connection.title: Finding Connection
loneliness_connection.intro: Can you tell me a bit about what loneliness feels like for you right now?
loneliness_connection.needs: What kind of connection do you most long for?
loneliness_connection.person_option: Is there anyone, even a small connection, you could reach out to?
loneliness_connection.small_reach_out_step: What's one tiny step toward connection you could take?
loneliness_connection.self_compassion: What kind words would you say to a friend feeling this way?
loneliness_connection.summary: You're experiencing loneliness, especially {{lonely_moment}}. You long for {{lonely_need}}. You might reach out to {{lonely_person}} by {{lonely_action}}. Self-compassion: {{lonely_self_compassion}}.

anger_boundaries.title: Anger and Boundaries

level_1.title: PART 1: I AM
level_1.intro: We dive into the very foundation — the 'biological zero'. This is the level of survival at the cellular level, where consciousness is not yet separated from metabolic processes. The main goal is to shift the system from 'anxious anticipation' and deficit mode to 'safe being'.
level_1.basis: At this level, we work with the most ancient brain structures that govern life before we begin to think about it: primary interoception (brainstem-insula connection), vagal tone (exiting 'freeze' or 'flight'), sensory navigation (thalamic calibration), and activation of proto-consciousness through direct contact with physiological rhythms.
level_1.architecture_intro: This protocol is aimed at calibrating basic survival settings, transforming the body from a 'besieged fortress' into a 'safe home':
level_1.pillar_1_text: Working with the hypothalamus to establish internal equilibrium and efficient distribution of the body's resources.
level_1.pillar_2_text: Practices for developing the ability to sense pulsation, pressure, and movement of internal organs as the foundation of self-awareness.
level_1.pillar_3_text: Training the thalamus to filter out unnecessary stimuli, reducing the overall load on the nervous system. Using neuroplasticity to strengthen the connection between mental state and immune response at the cellular level.
level_1.pillar_4_text: Releasing spasms from the main breathing muscle to free the vagus nerve and initiate deep parasympathetic recovery.
level_1.bio_focus_intro: The main goal is activating 'proto-consciousness' and creating an unconditional sense of safety.
level_1.bio_focus_1: Insular cortex (Insula): The main hub of interoception and self-perception.
level_1.bio_focus_2: Brainstem and Hypothalamus: Centers controlling life support and homeostasis.
level_1.bio_focus_3: Vagus nerve and Diaphragm: The main highway of the parasympathetic system and the engine of breathing.
level_1.result_intro: The result of completing Part 1 is finding your 'point of stillness'. Your progress biomarkers:
level_1.result_3: Restored rhythmic peristalsis and stable deep breathing.
level_1.result_outro: You teach your nervous system to feel safety and the fact of existence without any external conditions. This is the state from which any quality movement ('I move') and any transformation ('I adapt') becomes possible.

level_2.title: PART 2: I MOVE
level_2.protocol: Protocol: Rhythmic Coherence and Primary Locomotion
level_2.intro: Transition from the static state of 'I am' to the dynamic 'I swim'. At this stage, we awaken primary motor function and master navigation in flow. This is the engineering setup of the 'liquid body', where movement doesn't require exhausting effort but is born from resonance with the environment.
level_2.basis: We descend to the level of 'fish intelligence' — activating ancient brainstem structures and spinal cord circuits responsible for automatic grace and survival: activating CPGs (spinal generators of ordered rhythms), engaging primary motor circuits of the brainstem, working with spinal micro-movements, and learning to navigate through the flow of incoming stimuli.
level_2.architecture_intro: This protocol transforms the 'Fish' metaphor into a clear sequence for tuning neural fluidity:
level_2.pillar_1_text: Activation of spinal cord centers to create natural, 'autopilot' locomotion. Movement becomes effortless, like swimming.
level_2.pillar_2_text: Gaze stabilization during head movement. This is the foundation for visual navigation and the feeling of stability within the flow.
level_2.pillar_3_text: Increasing heart rate variability (HRV) through synchronization of axial movements with the breathing cycle.
level_2.pillar_4_text: Transferring effort through fascial chains, allowing the whole body to move as a single vector. Training the brain to use minimal electrical impulse for maximum biomechanical result.
level_2.bio_focus_intro: The main goal is launching the body's wave dynamics and radically reducing the coefficient of internal resistance.
level_2.bio_focus_1: Spine: The axial skeleton as the main waveguide of movement.
level_2.bio_focus_2: Spinal neural circuits and Cerebellum: Centers of rhythmic movement, smoothness modulation, and noise elimination.
level_2.bio_focus_3: Vestibular system: The primary gyroscope for orientation in flow.
level_2.result_intro: The result of completing Part 2 is achieving 'neural fluidity'. Your progress biomarkers:
level_2.result_2: Improved fascial gliding and synovial joint lubrication.
level_2.result_3: Synchronization of breathing and movement into a single cycle.
level_2.result_outro: You stop 'pushing' yourself through space and begin moving within it, using inertia, rhythm, and the natural curves of the spine. The body becomes responsive, and navigation becomes intuitive.

level_3.title: PART 3: I ADAPT
level_3.intro: This stage is dedicated to mastering gravity and transitioning from a state of 'floating' (complete dependence on the environment) to 'grounding' (acquiring inner autonomy). Here we lay the foundation for how our body interacts with the physical world. We move from passive survival to active control of our position in space.
level_3.basis: From a neurophysiological perspective, we work with the deepest, most automated processes. The primary goal is tuning the brainstem and reticular formation, as well as activating the primary sensorimotor cortex: tone management (optimizing the balance between flexor and extensor muscles), training rapid switching between 'relaxation/fluidity' and 'tone/stability' states, and activating spinal pattern generators for natural locomotion.
level_3.architecture_intro: The protocol is aimed at deep attunement of the body with Earth's physical constants. Each practice has a clear scientific foundation:
level_3.pillar_1_text: Synchronization of breathing cycles with micro-movements to tune cardiovascular resonance.
level_3.pillar_2_text: Working with Central Pattern Generators in the spinal cord. We transform the metaphor of 'swimming in the ocean' into an algorithm for light and efficient movement.
level_3.pillar_3_text: Training the coupling of eye and head movements for gaze stabilization and orientation.
level_3.pillar_4_text: Developing the skill of awareness of internal states (organ signals, pressure, heartbeat), which is the foundation for emotional intelligence. Training the nervous system to perform tasks with minimal necessary muscular effort, eliminating parasitic tension.
level_3.bio_focus_intro: The Part 3 technology stack is aimed at optimizing the proprioceptive feedback loop (the 'brain — muscles — brain' chain).
level_3.bio_focus_1: Vestibular system: Stabilization in space and navigation.
level_3.bio_focus_2: Cerebellum: Coordination and precision of movements.
level_3.bio_focus_3: Vagus nerve (ventral branch): Social engagement and biological sense of safety.
level_3.result_intro: The result of completing Part 3 is deep adaptation of the body to the physical world. Your progress biomarkers:
level_3.result_2: Stabilization of breathing rhythm under physical load.
level_3.result_outro: A transition from 'floating' (chaotic response to external stimuli) to 'grounding' (the ability to maintain centeredness and stability in any changing environment). You transform your body from an object upon which gravity acts into a subject that uses gravity as a resource.

level_4.title: PART 4: I MANEUVER
level_4.intro: Welcome to the stage where biological flexibility transforms into applied mastery. While previous stages taught us simply to 'be', here we learn to be in motion.
level_4.basis: Part 4 is built on the evolutionary gift of small mammals: the ability to instantly dodge, navigate precisely, and micro-avoid threats without falling into paralyzing stress. We transform agility from a matter of luck into a measurable biological skill.
level_4.architecture_intro: Our practices are built upon four pillars of modern science:
level_4.pillar_1_text: Training the nervous system to smoothly 'drift' between the Ventral Vagus (social engagement and safety state) and Sympathetic activation (energy for action). Using sympathetic tone for maneuvering without falling into panic or rage.
level_4.pillar_2_text: We train the chain: Reticular Formation → Thalamus → Motor Cortex. This allows the brain to read environmental changes (neuroception) and produce a response 'before thought', bypassing slow cognitive filters.
level_4.pillar_3_text: Direct influence on the HPA axis (hypothalamus-pituitary-adrenal). We teach the body to control cortisol and adrenaline release, turning them from poison into fuel for precision.
level_4.pillar_4_text: Using muscle tone as a natural pump to cleanse the body of stress metabolites, ensuring physical freshness even under high load.
level_4.bio_focus_intro: Instead of rigid reflexes, we develop sensorimotor emotional reactivity.
level_4.bio_focus_1: Vestibular system: Precise orientation in chaos.
level_4.bio_focus_2: Proprioception: Sensing trajectory and the boundaries of your safety 'bubble'.
level_4.bio_focus_3: Diffuse perception: 360° attention field that allows seeing the world as a stream of opportunities rather than obstacles.
level_4.result_intro: The result of completing Part 4 is high cognitive selectivity. You gain the ability to:
level_4.result_1: Reduce impulsivity, replacing it with conscious speed.
level_4.result_2: Execute soft and quick transitions in life and work.
level_4.result_3: Use micro-movements and breathing for real-time self-regulation.
level_4.result_outro: Emotional navigation at this stage is not cognitive calculation but a sensory process. You don't think about how to dodge — you feel the trajectory and flow along it.

level_5.title: PART 5: I GUARD MY TERRITORY
level_5.protocol: Protocol: The Power of the 'Large Mammal'
level_5.intro: At this stage, we stop maneuvering and start claiming space. We move to working with the body's biochemical reactor at the level of a 'large beast'. Here, emotion is viewed not as an abstract feeling, but as a bioengineering process with a hormonal signature, neuromotor pattern, and autonomic profile.
level_5.basis: In Part 5, our focus is homeostasis. This is the ability to maintain the stability of the internal environment, the density of presence, and status-level calm, regardless of whatever external pressure the world exerts on us.
level_5.architecture_intro: We recalibrate the body through four key systems:
level_5.pillar_1_text: The adrenal glands switch from emergency cortisol release to producing DHEA — the hormone of vitality and longevity. The Pituitary-Gonadal axis creates a 'winner state' through moderate testosterone stimulation. The thymus restores the connection between the feeling of social safety and immune response strength.
level_5.pillar_2_text: Building on Stephen Porges' Polyvagal Theory, we activate the ventral vagus. This is the state of 'calm alertness', where the heart beats powerfully and steadily, and the brain is ready for effective dominance rather than panic.
level_5.pillar_3_text: Chronic stress locks up the diaphragm and pelvic floor. Our 'weight' and 'volume' practices work as deep lymphatic drainage, literally squeezing stress metabolites out of tissues.
level_5.pillar_4_text: We work on 'density of presence'. From a biophotonics perspective, this is a state of high coherence (order) in the electromagnetic field of cells. Your presence becomes physically perceptible to those around you.
level_5.bio_focus_intro: The Part 5 protocol engages deep layers of regulation:
level_5.bio_focus_1: Hypothalamus: Control of territorial behavior and dominance.
level_5.bio_focus_2: Basal ganglia: Formation of stable, 'unbreakable' postures.
level_5.bio_focus_3: Deep postural muscles: Creating an internal framework of strength.
level_5.result_intro: Chain: Hypothalamus activation → Testosterone increase → Cortisol decrease. This produces a state of calm dominance without aggression.
level_5.result_1: You broadcast status through neuromotor signals.
level_5.result_2: Others read your stability and limbic confidence before you say your first word.
level_5.result_3: Your body is not just a shell — it is your territory. It's time to claim it.
level_5.result_outro: Calm dominance is a biological state. It requires no effort when your hormonal profile and autonomic tone are properly calibrated.

level_6.title: PART 6: I AM IN THE PACK
level_6.protocol: Protocol: Social Resonance of the 'Higher Primate'
level_6.intro: Welcome to the summit of Level 2. If in previous stages we built maneuverability and personal boundaries, in Part 6 we move to the most complex biological interface — social resonance.
level_6.basis: Biologically, this is the 'Higher Primate' stage. Our task is to transform individual survival into collective power. We learn to synchronize our biological rhythms with the rhythms of others without losing our own 'coherent center'. We don't just exist near people — we enter into resonance.
level_6.architecture_intro: This protocol is based on activating the 'social brain':
level_6.pillar_1_text: Your biological Wi-Fi. We train the ability to instantly read the intentions and states of others through micro-expressions and gestures, turning intuition into a precision navigation tool.
level_6.pillar_2_text: We work with the hormone of trust and belonging. The goal is to teach the system to produce oxytocin in response to safe social contact, which automatically reduces background anxiety and aggression levels.
level_6.pillar_3_text: Activation of 'smart parasympathetics'. This is the state where facial muscles and hearing are tuned to the human voice and face, enabling co-regulation — the ability to calm down through another person and to calm others.
level_6.pillar_4_text: Training the social error and signal detector. We learn 'emotional osmosis' — the exchange of states — while maintaining autonomy and not falling into someone else's chaos.
level_6.bio_focus_intro: The Part 6 protocol targets limbic resonance:
level_6.bio_focus_1: Synchronization: The ability to attune breathing and heart rate to the group to create a unified field of action.
level_6.bio_focus_2: Micro-facial mobility: Reading and broadcasting safety and status signals through the finest facial movements.
level_6.bio_focus_3: Autonomous co-regulation: The ability to influence the emotional field of a group while remaining in a ventral-vagal state.
level_6.result_intro: Chain: Mirror neurons + Ventral Vagus + Oxytocin. The result is social engagement without anxiety.
level_6.result_1: You gain the ability to feel the pack, influence it, and use collective resources to achieve your goals.
level_6.result_2: Your presence becomes the glue that unites the group and the vector that guides it.
level_6.result_3: You are part of the whole, but you remain yourself.
level_6.result_outro: It's time to enter into resonance.

level_7.title: PART 7: I DISCERN
level_7.protocol: Protocol: Cognitive Control and S/N (Signal/Noise) Optimization
level_7.intro: At this stage, we rise above limbic reactions and instincts. The focus is on the foundation of intelligence: the brain's ability to extract 'signal' from 'noise'. We train the mind not to 'think thoughts', but to purely perceive the discreteness of the world — forms, contours, structures.
level_7.basis: This is the first level where the cognitive system takes on the role of lead conductor. The key biological challenge: increasing cognitive clarity and transitioning from reactivity to observation.
level_7.pillar_1_text: Sensory stream filter. Calibrating the thalamus to separate critically important information from background 'white noise'.
level_7.pillar_2_text: Command center for attention and executive functions. Activating the PFC–anterior cingulate cortex link for instant detection of discrepancies.
level_7.pillar_3_text: Using norepinephrine modulation to increase vigilance and inhibitory control over impulsive reactions. Metacognitive monitoring — training the medial PFC to separate facts from subjective interpretations.
level_7.pillar_4_text: Developing the ability to extract key signals from a dense stream of external stimuli. Deep processing of contours, shapes, and motion vectors through the visual cortex (V1–V5).
level_7.bio_focus_1: Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex (DL-PFC): Cognitive clarity and focus retention. Anterior Cingulate Cortex (ACC): High-precision 'error detector' and differentiator.
level_7.bio_focus_2: Increased P300 amplitude: An indicator of how quickly and efficiently the brain identifies a significant stimulus.
level_7.bio_focus_3: Saccade stability: Precision and control of eye micro-movements when scanning space. Perception stabilization through entering theta/alpha state.
level_7.result_intro: Creation of a 'cognitive gap' between stimulus and response.
level_7.result_1: You gain the ability to see the world as it truly is.
level_7.result_2: You recognize patterns before they capture your attention.
level_7.result_3: You maintain crystal-clear thinking even amid information overload.
level_7.result_outro: Radical reduction of cognitive load through sharpening the tools of perception.

level_8.title: PART 8: I FOCUS
level_8.protocol: Protocol: Cognitive Control and Neural Resilience
level_8.intro: Part 8 is the heart of the cognitive level. Here, attention ceases to be a reactive response to external stimuli and becomes a controlled instrument. We learn to choose what matters in the present moment and hold that focus, ignoring noise. This is the stage of transforming attention from chaotic to deliberate.
level_8.basis: At this stage, we work with the architecture of attention and the mechanisms for suppressing 'internal noise'. The key biological challenge: maintaining a target and efficiently distributing cognitive energy.
level_8.architecture_intro: Target systems and deep work mechanisms:
level_8.pillar_1_text: The Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex is the chief controller of goal retention. Strengthening the PFC–basal ganglia link for seamless return to target and filtering of impulsive urges.
level_8.pillar_2_title: Dorsal Attention Network (DAN) and DMN Suppression
level_8.pillar_2_text: Activating the voluntary, directed attention network. Training the brain to timely switch off 'mind-wandering mode' (Default Mode Network) for deep task immersion.
level_8.pillar_3_text: Synchronizing neurons at gamma frequency to assemble scattered perceptual elements into a unified, coherent image. Working with acetylcholine, which literally 'spotlights' the needed neural connections.
level_8.pillar_4_text: Regulating alertness levels through norepinephrine. Anterior Cingulate Cortex (ACC) — monitoring distractions and detecting errors.
level_8.bio_focus_intro: Tuning the brain for 'deep work' mode and preventing cognitive burnout:
level_8.bio_focus_1: Neural stabilization of the DLPFC for rigid focus control. Dopamine calibration — micro-rewards to maintain high motivation and working memory capacity.
level_8.bio_focus_2: Ultradian optimization: working in natural rhythms (90/20 minute cycles) for timely neurotransmitter recovery.
level_8.bio_focus_3: Metacognitive return: gentle, effortless redirection of attention to the focus object. Vagal brake: breathing to maintain body calm during high-intensity mental focus.
level_8.result_1: You don't just concentrate — you become the master of your attention.
level_8.result_2: The brain learns to enter deep focus without excessive effort, maintaining clarity and conserving biological energy.
level_8.result_3: Optimization of cognitive inhibition — the system's ability to actively ignore irrelevant stimuli.
level_8.result_outro: Increased beta-rhythm power in frontal lobes, heart rate stabilization, and reduced reaction time when switching between tasks.

level_9.title: PART 9: I CREATE THE IMAGE
level_9.protocol: Protocol: Mental Simulation and Neural Plasticity
level_9.intro: Part 9 is the moment of launching internal 'rendering'. Here, imagination is viewed not as idle fantasy, but as a powerful biological tool for designing behavior. We move from analyzing the present to modeling the future, creating mental prototypes of reality.
level_9.basis: At this level, we engage the brain's highest integrative systems to assemble scattered fragments of experience into a unified image. The key biological challenge: creating an accurate predictive model of reality (Predictive Coding).
level_9.architecture_intro: Target systems and mental modeling mechanisms:
level_9.pillar_1_text: Architecture and evaluation of future strategies. The conductor directing the creative process. The hypothalamus translates mental images into chemical responses (hormones and neurotransmitters).
level_9.pillar_2_text: Reconstructing past experience to model new scenarios. DMN — the brain's passive mode network responsible for creative insight and visualization.
level_9.pillar_3_text: Visualization and rendering of images in the absence of external stimuli. Instantaneous unification of neural ensembles for a 'flash' of understanding and image coherence.
level_9.pillar_4_text: Assembling spatial maps and fitting the image into the environmental context. Synchronizing the mental sketch with the body's physiological response.
level_9.bio_focus_intro: Teaching the brain to use imagination as a program for reprogramming reality:
level_9.bio_focus_1: Sensory visualization: activating the primary sensory cortex to create deep, 'tangible' internal experience. Mental modeling: hippocampus–mPFC link for rehearsing future scenarios.
level_9.bio_focus_2: Proactive programming (RAS): calibrating the reticular activating system for automatic scanning of opportunities matching the internal image.
level_9.bio_focus_3: Neural reframing: cognitive metaphors for rewiring synaptic connections. Biochemical resonance: teaching the hypothalamus to generate a 'victory' state before actual action begins.
level_9.result_intro: Transforming imagination into a tool for managing reality.
level_9.result_1: You gain the ability not just to react to events, but to 'prescribe' them in advance at the neural level.
level_9.result_2: The image becomes a program, and the brain becomes an efficient executor finding the shortest paths to the goal.
level_9.result_3: Predominance of alpha and theta rhythms characteristic of creative flow and insight states.
level_9.result_outro: Changes in galvanic skin response (GSR) — an indicator that the body 'believes' in the created image.

level_10.title: PART 10: I EXPRESS
level_10.protocol: Protocol: Neuroendocrinology of Influence and Vocal Resonance
level_10.intro: This is the stage of social realization and tempering. Here, the 'internal sketch' created at the Mind level must pass through the filter of the external environment. The task is to synchronize the heart (feelings), brain (image), and throat (instrument of manifestation). We transform self-expression into a sovereign act.
level_10.basis: At this level, a powerful leap occurs: the brain engages social monitoring and speech production systems. The key biological challenge: overcoming social fear and transitioning from internal simulation to real manifestation.
level_10.architecture_intro: Target systems and social manifestation mechanisms:
level_10.pillar_1_title: Broca's Area, Wernicke's Area, and the Ventral Vagus
level_10.pillar_1_text: Centers for assembling and delivering speech constructs. The ventral vagus — the 'social brake' ensuring a state of calm engagement and friendliness.
level_10.pillar_2_text: Reducing amygdala reactivity to suppress paralyzing social fear. Mirror neurons — reading audience reactions and instantly adapting to context.
level_10.pillar_3_text: The insula — sensing authenticity, how well your words match your internal state. The laryngeal nerve and vocal apparatus — instruments of sound resonance.
level_10.pillar_4_text: The thyroid gland — driver of metabolic tempo and manifestation energy. The prefrontal cortex — social modeling and impulse control.
level_10.bio_focus_intro: Transforming the body into a powerful transmitter of ideas through neurochemistry mechanisms:
level_10.bio_focus_1: Hormonal engineering: 'power poses' and breathing patterns to lower cortisol and raise testosterone. Vagal stimulation: vocal exercises to activate the ventral vagus.
level_10.bio_focus_2: Prefrontal control (Reappraisal): cognitive reappraisal that physiologically dampens amygdala activity, replacing fear with excitement. Oxytocin loops: managing eye contact and facial expressions.
level_10.bio_focus_3: Personality embodiment: practices for the bodily sensation of 'I speak', where the voice is supported by the entire body volume — diaphragm, feet, spine.
level_10.result_intro: Transitioning from 'social paralysis' to the state of Manifestation Master.
level_10.result_1: Your voice gains weight, words gain precision, and self-expression becomes sovereign, clear, and authentic.
level_10.result_2: You no longer fear being noticed — you use attention as fuel for your manifestation.
level_10.result_3: Optimization of testosterone-to-cortisol ratio, changes in voice timbre and amplitude.
level_10.result_outro: Removal of social filters and tuning the resonant sound of personality. Absence of jaw muscle spasm and throat tension.

level_11.title: PART 11: I INTERACT
level_11.protocol: Protocol: Social Cognition and Empathic Regulation
level_11.intro: Part 11 is the transition from self-expression to interference. In physics, this is the moment of superposition of two waves creating a new complex pattern. In ONDA, this is tuning your 'neural Wi-Fi'. We learn to be with another so that interaction doesn't become a conflict of interests or manipulation.
level_11.basis: At this level, the 'social brain' is activated — the most complex network responsible for interpersonal synchronization. The key biological challenge: balance between preserving autonomy ('I') and deep connection ('We').
level_11.architecture_intro: Target systems and interpersonal interaction mechanisms:
level_11.pillar_1_title: Mirror Neurons and Theory of Mind (ToM) Network
level_11.pillar_1_text: Direct resonance of actions and emotions — the foundation for instant empathy. The mPFC's ability to understand perspectives, intentions, and beliefs of another person.
level_11.pillar_2_text: Ensuring social harmony and ethical choice in the moment. The ventral vagus creates a physiological 'container' of safety for open communication.
level_11.pillar_3_text: The medial prefrontal cortex — center for understanding another's 'Self'. The right temporoparietal junction (rTPJ) — key node for reading nonverbal signals and 'theory of mind'.
level_11.pillar_4_text: Biochemical balance between trust and boundary protection. The phenomenon where partners' brain rhythms begin operating in coherent mode.
level_11.bio_focus_intro: Calibrating interpersonal navigation instruments to the highest level of precision:
level_11.bio_focus_1: Empathic calibration: activating mirror neurons and the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) for reading subtle emotional micro-signals. Cognitive flexibility (ToM): training the ability to 'walk in another's shoes'.
level_11.bio_focus_2: Social predictive coding: teaching the brain to predict partner reactions, reducing social noise. Stimulating oxytocin loops to shift the system into deep cooperation mode.
level_11.bio_focus_3: Interoception in contact: using the insular cortex (Insula) for real-time sensing of one's own and others' boundaries, preventing fusion or alienation.
level_11.result_1: You learn to create resonance that strengthens both participants in the process.
level_11.result_2: Interaction becomes effortless, productive, and biologically nourishing.
level_11.result_3: HRV synchronization between partners and alpha-rhythmic brain coherence.
level_11.result_outro: Transition from 'social survival' strategies to 'social resonance' strategies. Relaxation of the pelvic diaphragm and release of deep bodily blocks.

level_12.title: PART 12: I CO-CREATE
level_12.protocol: Protocol: Neural Synchronization and Collective Intelligence
level_12.intro: Part 12 is the culmination of ONDA's social evolution. We transition from 'I' to 'WE' without losing individuality, entering a state of neural coupling. This is the point where the intelligence, emotions, and meanings of a group synchronize, creating a collective flow.
level_12.basis: At this level, the brain demonstrates the highest form of interpersonal coordination — synchronous operation of rhythms across multiple individuals. The key biological challenge: integrating individual consciousness into a collective neural network.
level_12.architecture_intro: Target systems and collective co-creation mechanisms:
level_12.pillar_1_text: Inter-brain synchronization where participants' neural patterns begin to mirror each other. Gamma rhythm (40+ Hz) is responsible for collective insight and instantaneous synthesis of ideas.
level_12.pillar_2_text: Suppressing the brain's 'ego network' to transition from protecting personal boundaries to pursuing a common goal. Joint Attention — forming a unified focus as the center of group synergy.
level_12.pillar_3_text: Coordinator of joint actions and shared strategies. The anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) smooths micro-conflicts and calibrates the group's tempo.
level_12.pillar_4_text: The temporoparietal junction (TPJ) — deep understanding of each participant's intentions and contribution. Endorphin and oxytocin systems — the hormonal glue of collective cohesion.
level_12.bio_focus_intro: Transforming 'teamwork' into a measurable process of biological attunement:
level_12.bio_focus_1: Neural Coupling: practices for synchronizing attention and breathing rhythms to enter a shared neural field. Idea depersonalization: reducing ego-centered network (DMN) activity.
level_12.bio_focus_2: Oxytocin resonance: reducing amygdala reactivity within the group through an atmosphere of radical trust. Intention synchronization: high-order mirror systems for 'seamless' execution of joint tasks.
level_12.bio_focus_3: Dopamine reinforcement: protocols for celebrating collective victories to form stable neural circuits of cooperative behavior.
level_12.result_1: You gain the skill of integrating into group processes of any complexity while preserving sovereignty and multiplying the collective result.
level_12.result_2: The group transforms into a living neural network capable of solving problems inaccessible to an individual mind.
level_12.result_3: Inter-brain coherence, group heart rate variability, and collective dopamine.
level_12.result_outro: Creating a hyper-productive environment where ideas self-organize into results through 'We-consciousness'.
